All 69 short headings in 2609.00246 are `inline-block` in stack and share a line (“Abstract” 0–90, “摘要” 90–157). In side, **zero** remain inline-block: all become block, original 0–648 left, translation 672–1320 right, same row. Adding `html[data-axt-mode="stack"]` changes no output and adds a mode check to maintain; do not add it. `modes.css` already has a dedicated side `[data-axt-inline]` translation rule clearing the 0.5em start margin, confirming intent. `e2e:layout` asserts block display, left/right placement, and equal rows.

exceptions.text: **Translation-quality measurements** (google-web, the worst case among free engines): 28 of 30 were normal transliterations, even recovering Chinese characters for names (`Yuan Xia` → 袁霞, `Haipeng Cai` → 蔡海鹏, `Fumihiro Imoto` → 井本文宏; exact characters are guesses). One failure: **`Brian Street` → 布莱恩街**, treating the surname as a common noun. Roughly 3% error, visibly wrong, with the original beside it. LLMs have title/abstract context and should do better. **No prompt change**: adding a constraint to every batch for a few names is not worthwhile, and bumping `PROMPT_VERSION` invalidates all caches; revisit only with real feedback.
exceptions.reason: Recorded name transliterations and mistranslations preserve the evidence behind the author-translation decision.

exceptions.text: **Translation-quality measurements** (google-web, worst-case free engine): standalone author segments are **more likely to be transliterated** than full citations. Google tends to preserve names in full citations (`W. Arendt 和 AFM ter Elst`, `Agha, G., Palmskog, K.:`), but transliterates separate segments (`史蒂文·阿兹特、齐格弗里德·拉斯托弗…`). Two specific defects: institutional authors treated as common words (`Anthropic.` → `人类学。`), and initials losing periods (`V. I.` → `VI`, `M. D.` → `MD`, resembling Roman numerals). **The LLM path does not have this problem**: the default instruction “Keep author names, journal names, conference names, dataset names, code identifiers and URLs in the original language” returns author segments unchanged.
exceptions.reason: Observed citation and institutional-author translations document quality defects.

exceptions.text: - **Send glossary with every batch** [Decided, 2026-09-05]: configuration `glossary: { term, translation }[]` since v6; options text editor uses one entry/line, comma or tab delimiters, `#` comments. `providers/glossary.ts` parses/deduplicates (KISS `parseAITerms` shape plus tabs, comments, and line-numbered errors instead of silent dropping). **Semicolons do not separate records**: KISS splits `a, 甲; b, 乙`, but legitimate translations can contain semicolons (`kernel, 核; 统计学中称核函数`); splitting silently corrupts one valid mapping into unrelated records (Codex #52). **200 entries maximum**: every batch carries them, roughly 2–3KB / 700 tokens, comparable to an abstract. Larger glossaries need per-paragraph matching, deferred to v2. Per-entry limits: source 120 characters, translation 200; total 6000, preventing an entire pasted document being accepted as one entry. Define limits in `GLOSSARY_LIMITS`; **migrations must run `normalizeGlossary`**, as v6 had no limits and blindly copying into v7 makes `getConfig()` reject the whole configuration and revert to defaults, appearing to lose keys, engines, and prompts (Codex #52). **Automatically append `{{glossary}}` when custom prompts omit it**, like `{{input}}` / `{{targetLanguage}}`; new templates otherwise omit it and configured glossaries have no effect. This changes model input, so `PROMPT_VERSION` becomes 4 (hard rule 6). **Omit the field for empty glossaries**, rather than sending `[]`: `contextPayload` keys empty and absent identically, preserving existing cache on feature introduction while changed translations invalidate affected entries. LLM-only: free engines ignore context; `translate-service` includes context in cache keys only when `provider.promptKey` exists.
exceptions.reason: Glossary data examples demonstrate delimiter compatibility and semicolon preservation.

exceptions.text: - **Short headings share a line** [Decided]: for `title` units other than the document title with visible text ≤60 characters, add `data-axt-inline` to original and translation. CSS sets both to `display: inline-block` (retaining vertical heading margins) and gives the translation 0.5em start margin, producing “Abstract 摘要” on one line. Reference projects achieve this by inserting translations inside originals; our subtree invariant requires attributes + CSS. Keep the main title stacked: its `text-align: center` no longer centers it when inline.
exceptions.reason: Bilingual heading sample illustrates the intended inline layout.

exceptions.text: - **Translate `.ltx_tag` containing environment names** [Decided, 2026-09-05, user feedback]: LaTeXML also puts theorem, figure, table, algorithm, and appendix **names** in `.ltx_tag`. Protecting all of `Definition 1.1.` as a number leaves Chinese readers with English. Distinguish subclasses: translate `ltx_tag_theorem` / `ltx_tag_figure` / `ltx_tag_table` / `ltx_tag_float` / `ltx_tag_appendix` / `ltx_tag_part` / `ltx_tag_chapter`; keep others (equation, section, subsection, ref, item, note) void. **Classes alone are insufficient**: subfigure panels also use `.ltx_tag_figure` for pure identifiers `(a)` `(b)` `(c)` (5 of 387 named tags, Codex #53); translating them can rewrite identifiers and break panel correspondence. Add `isNamedTag`: class must be listed and, **after removing parenthesized identifier-only groups**, contain at least two consecutive letters. Keep parentheses containing non-Roman words: `(Figure 1)` must not lose its environment name (Codex #53). Counting letters alone misses multi-letter Roman panel IDs `(ii)` `(iii)`; LaTeXML uses parentheses for identifiers, not environment names (`Definition 1.2 (Hall set)` retains Definition and still translates). Evidence: all 1241 `.ltx_tag` across 12 fixtures: 246 theorem tags all resemble “Definition 1”, 43 table tags “Table 1:”, 58 of 63 figure tags “Figure 1.”, 20 appendix tags “Appendix A”, 13 float tags “Algorithm 1”; conversely, only 13 of 344 equation tags contain letters (untouchable LaTeX labels such as `(let.lin)`), all letter-bearing tags among 439 section/subsection/ref tags are Roman numerals (II, III.1), and 54 note tags are footnote markers. **Never translate Roman-numbered labels**: google-gtx tests on 2026-09-05 (Codex #53) gave `Table IV:` → `表四：`, `Table X:` → `表十：`, `Part I` → `第一部分`, while references remain protected originals, breaking correspondence. Arabic numbers (`Table 4:` → `表 4：`), letter numbering (`Appendix A` → `附录A`), and parenthesized panels (`Figure 1(a)`) retained their identifiers. Google itself treats only I / V / X / L / M as numbers, and single C / D as letters; `ROMAN_ID` follows this. For compound numbering, inspect the first part (`Table IV.1` → 表四.1; both `IV.1` / `IV-A` are Roman), case-insensitively (LaTeX `\roman`: `Table iv:` → 表四：). `fixtures-stats.ts` must also count rule hits through `classify()`, not selectors, or allowed tags are incorrectly counted as protect/tag. Papers use consistent numbering styles, so readers will not see “表 4” and “Table IV” together. Fixture result: 368 of 387 named tags translate, 19 remain protected (5 panel labels + 13 Roman-numbered tables + `Part I`). Bump `RULES_VERSION` (cache key), now 0.6.2. Measured in 2609.04056v1: theorem-title blocks increased from 34 to 75; `Definition 1.2 (Hall set).` → `定义 1.2（大厅布置）。`
exceptions.reason: Exact translated labels and numbering failures document the protection rule and its evidence.

exceptions.text: - **Translate description-list terms too** [Decided, 2026-09-06, Codex #18]: LaTeXML puts the term from `\item[Compactness]` in `.ltx_tag.ltx_tag_item`. Protected tags leave `.ltx_item` with no own text, so it **never becomes a block** and the term never translates. Add `.ltx_tag_item` to `NAMED_TAGS`, using existing content checks: of 371 across 12 fixtures, only 8 contain words (`Markov categories:`, `CD categories:`, `Compactness.`, `RQ1`–`RQ5`); the other 363 are markers such as `(1)` and `•`, still void. google-web returned `RQ1` unchanged and translated `Markov categories:` as “马尔可夫分类：”, leaving identifiers intact. The snapshot delta is exactly these 8.
